dateline: Hawthorne, CA / Boca Chica, TX — May 2002–Present
heroHeadline: IFT-12 Delayed to Late May After OLP-2 Deluge Explosion — 56 Launches, 609 Landings; Public S-1 ~11 Days Out
heroSubtitle: 8,767 days of SpaceX milestones — OLP-2 water deluge gas generator explosion (May 5–6) pushed Starship IFT-12 (Booster 19 / Ship 39 / Block 3 V3, 100t+ LEO) to late May 2026 target (est. May 27–31); deluge repair est. 2–3 weeks, stack unaffected. SpaceX's 56th orbital mission of 2026: Starlink 17-29 (24 sats, Vandenberg SLC-4E, OCISLY, 609th booster landing, May 6 UTC). SpaceX filed 'Terafab' plans — $55B semiconductor facility in Grimes County TX (Tesla JV, Intel 14A, $119B total potential). Public IPO S-1 expected May 15–22; June 18–30 Nasdaq debut at $1.75T valuation ($75B raise).
